brief:
One year after the death of Palestinian journalist Mariam Abu Daqa, the British newspaper The Independent has returned to scrutinize the attack that killed her and several other journalists inside Nasser Hospital in Khanyounis in southern Gaza, Shehab Wire reported. The outlet's renewed examination comes as it investigates the circumstances and details surrounding the incident at the medical facility.

Abu Daqa was among multiple journalists killed in the strike on the hospital. The Independent's reporting marks a continued effort to document and assess the attack that claimed her life alongside her colleagues, drawing renewed attention to the deaths of media workers during the conflict in Gaza.
